user.title: Connect ZSpace NAS
user.description: The CLI binary ships with this integration. The session is stored in `{profile_dir}`. Submit, then authorize via the link if needed.

data_description.binary_path: Bundled binary is picked by CPU architecture, usually leave empty.
data_description.host: Empty uses the oauth.zconnect.cn relay; https://IP:5055 for direct LAN.
data_description.allow_insecure_http: Only when the device has no trusted certificate.

auth.title: Authorize ZSpace
auth.description:
Open the link below, sign in and approve, then paste the one-time code here.

**{url}**

The link is valid for {expires_in} seconds; an expired link is regenerated.

error.auth: Session invalid or expired, please reauthorize
error.binary_missing: Bundled CLI missing or not executable; check the HACS installation
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the NAS, check address and network
error.invalid_code: Invalid or expired code, retry with a fresh link
error.expired: Authorization timed out, request a new link
error.login_failed: Cannot start the authorization flow; check that the session directory is writable

abort.already_configured: This ZSpace device is already configured

data.dry_run: Dry run (log only, do not execute)

data_description.allow_control: Creates container switches and restart buttons. Delete, force-stop and engine power are never exposed.
data_description.allowed_containers: Comma separated name fragments; use * to allow all (protected system containers still denied). Empty = monitoring only.
data_description.dry_run: Switch presses are only logged, no command is sent. Useful to observe behaviour first.
data_description.protected_containers: Comma separated, matches name fragments. Names containing zspace/znas/zido/zvm are protected by default.
data_description.action_cooldown: Prevents scripts or double taps from hammering the same container.
data_description.download_interval: Download tasks change slowly, 5 minutes by default.
data_description.disk_interval: SMART is queried per disk (~0.4s each), 1 hour by default.
data_description.web_url: Shown as the device Visit link, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:5055. Empty hides it.
data_description.short_entity_ids: Renames entity IDs from pinyin to short English like zspace_cpu_usage (display names unchanged). Old IDs used in dashboards/automations will break; not reversible.
data_description.vnc_console: Open the VM screen inside Home Assistant via noVNC. Links are signed and expire in 12 hours.
data_description.vnc_host: Picked automatically from the VM endpoint list; set this to force an IP.
data_description.gpu_interval: External GPU and local AI task status; 5 min by default. Hidden automatically on unsupported models.
data_description.time_machine_interval: Backup status changes slowly; 15 min by default.
data_description.event_interval: System events / login log; 3 min by default. New alerts can be announced.
data_description.announce_events: When on, new warning-or-higher events are spoken; enabling first time only sets a baseline.
data_description.announce_media_player: Pick a media_player entity. Requires TTS configured in HA.
data_description.announce_min_level: Events below this level are not spoken, to avoid noise.

container_action.name: Container action
container_action.description: Start, stop or restart a ZSpace Docker container.

dump_raw.name: Dump raw data
dump_raw.description: Call one read-only capability and write the raw JSON to /config/zspace_nas/.

container_logs.name: Container logs
container_logs.description: Return the last 100 log lines; set save to also write them under /config/zspace_nas/.

vnc_url.name: VM console link
vnc_url.description: Sign a console link for a VM, valid for the given hours (default 12).

announce_test.name: Announcement test
announce_test.description: Speak a test message to verify media player and TTS setup.
